title: Ensemble Tool Category Contract Schema
description: Schema for packages/development/toolchain/categories/<category>.yaml: the versioned capability contract for one of the 14 tool categories (host, workflow, worktree, tracker, work-graph, ci-local, review, lint, test-runner, e2e-quality, container-deploy, iac, platform-cloud, package-runner). Each capability states its inputs, normalized outputs and whether it is required or optional (PRD REQ-002, AC-002-1).

category.description: One of the 14 taxonomy categories; must match the file's own base name.

version.description: The contract's own 'major.minor' version, independent of other categories and of Ensemble's release version (PRD REQ-003).

capabilities.description: Named capabilities of this category, keyed by capability id (for example 'tracker.show').

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the capability does.

outputs.description: Named fields of the capability's normalized output.

required.description: Whether a conforming adapter for this category must implement the capability.

sideEffect.description: Whether invoking the capability has an externally visible side effect (write outside the local working tree).

fallback.description: Id of the documented fallback used when an optional capability is absent from the resolved adapter (REQ-004).

addedInMinor.description: The minor version, within the capability's major, in which this capability was added (PRD REQ-003); absent means it shipped with the major's first minor.
